backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile management, role-based access control with a hardcoded admin principal, and admin-only queries for Google Sheets links and admin listings.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two features: fixing the Flow Control Pa line color inversion in FanVoltageFlowControlChart, and auto-zooming all charts to the last day of data on initial page load.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing their roles in the dashboard including charts, hooks, data fetching, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based color tokens for light and dark modes, including chart colors, sidebar, and UI component variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'Conceptmachine Live Data' and mounts the React app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that handles authentication gating, admin-only default-deny access control, page navigation filtered by ConceptMachine visibility, and passes hardcoded Google Sheets URLs to the title bar.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI component that displays either a loading spinner while checking admin permissions or an access-denied card with a button to navigate to the profile page.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/CO2Chart.tsx: Recharts line chart rendering three CO₂ series with auto-zoom to the last 24 hours on first data load, click-and-drag zoom via ReferenceArea, and a Brush component for pan/zoom.
frontend/src/components/CoolingHeatingVe: A Recharts line chart displaying cooling, heating, and ventilation percentages over time with drag-to-zoom, brush range selection, and auto-zoom to the last 24 hours on initial load.
frontend/src/components/DashboardCard.ts: A reusable card wrapper component with a styled header (title + optional action) and content area, built on top of shadcn/ui Card primitives.
frontend/src/components/FanVoltageFlowCo: A dual-Y-axis Recharts line chart showing fan voltages and flow control pressure over time, with drag-to-zoom, brush range selection, and auto-zoom to the last 24 hours.
frontend/src/components/LogSystemTitleBa: A responsive title bar for log system pages featuring navigation arrows, theme toggle, refresh, download (admin-only), and a mobile sheet menu with sign-out and principal copy functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileMenu.tsx: A dropdown profile menu showing the user's name and truncated principal, with options to copy the principal, navigate to the account page, and sign out.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A blocking modal dialog that prompts a newly authenticated user to enter their name and save their profile before proceeding.
frontend/src/components/TemperatureChart: A Recharts-based line chart component for displaying temperature data with drag-to-zoom, brush range selection, and auto-zoom to the last 24 hours on initial load.
A Recharts line chart rendering up to 72 TSIC sensor temperature lines with per-sensor visibility toggles, Y-axis clipping, drag-to-zoom, brush range selection, and auto-zoom to the last 24 hours.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) access, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminList.ts: Fetches the list of admins from the backend actor using React Query, only when the caller is confirmed as an admin.
frontend/src/hooks/useConceptMachineVisi: Provides hooks to fetch and update the ConceptMachine page visibility setting from the backend, with admin-only mutation support.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches the current authenticated user's profile from the backend actor via React Query, returning loading and error states.
Derives a formatted 'last updated' timestamp by subscribing to the React Query cache for the temperature-series query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGoogleSheetsDownlo: Fetches the Google Sheets download link from the backend actor via React Query, caching it indefinitely.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: Checks whether the current caller has admin privileges by querying the backend actor, defaulting to false on any error.
frontend/src/hooks/useLogSystemNavigatio: Manages navigation state (current index, next/previous/go-to) across a list of log system pages.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports mutations for saving user profiles and granting admin roles via the backend actor, with cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSyncedTimeWindow.t: Manages a time window (start/end index) state for chart zoom, providing helpers to set, reset, and clamp the range to data bounds.
Fetches temperature data series via React Query with manual-refresh-only behavior, tracking the last successful update time.
frontend/src/hooks/useThemeSession.ts: Manages dark/light theme state persisted to sessionStorage, syncing the document's CSS class on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useTSICData.ts: Fetches TSIC data points for a given ID using React Query with no automatic refetching and infinite stale time.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a light/dark theme with olive green accents, including chart-specific color variables.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureDataSource.t: Fetches raw temperature and CO2 data from a Google Apps Script endpoint and returns parsed TemperatureDataPoint arrays using the temperatureParsing module.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureParsing.ts: Defines the TemperatureDataPoint interface and provides parsing utilities to convert raw API data (with comma-decimal strings and DD/MM/YY timestamps) into typed, validated data points.
frontend/src/lib/tsicDataParsing.ts: Defines the TSICDataPoint interface with 72 sensor fields and parses raw TSIC logger JSON data, sorting results by timestamp.
frontend/src/lib/tsicDataSource.ts: Fetches TSIC sensor data for a given logger ID from a Google Apps Script endpoint and returns parsed TSICDataPoint arrays.
frontend/src/logSystems/logSystemPages.t: Defines and exports the list of log system page configurations (Conceptmachine, TSIC Loggers, Profile), each with an id, display name, subtitle, and component.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page component that displays a sign-in card using Internet Identity authentication, with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile page allowing users to update their display name, copy their principal, and (if admin) grant admin rights to others and toggle ConceptMachine visibility.
frontend/src/pages/TemperatureDashboardP: React dashboard page displaying temperature, CO2, cooling/heating/ventilation, and fan voltage charts with date range filtering and synced zoom controls.
frontend/src/pages/TSICLogger1Page.tsx: Empty or stub page file for the TSIC Logger 1 view with no visible content.
frontend/src/pages/TSICLoggersPage.tsx: React page for TSIC logger data visualization with sensor selection, date range filtering, Y-axis controls, sensor visibility toggles, and synced zoom across charts.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended fonts, border radii, shadows, and accordion keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the dashboard app's architecture, existing features, and pending fix requests for chart line colors and auto-zoom on load.
